The '''Twenty-Ninth Fleet''' was part of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[third Galactic War]].<ref name="GangsOfMekSha" />

==History==
In the year [[3627 BBY]],<ref name="TOR Dates Forums" /> during the [[third Galactic War]], the Twenty-Ninth Fleet stopped at [[Mek-Sha]] on its way to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to aid in the defense of the [[Meridian Complex]]. However, while on Mek-Sha, it was targeted by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], which aimed to destroy it so that it could not be able to continue on to Corellia.<ref name="GangsOfMekSha" />

{{GameLS|Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught}}
However, the Empire's plans to destroy the fleet were stopped by the [[Alliance Commander]], who battled through the Empire's forces, including [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Tarnux]] and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Anri]], and saved the fleet.<ref name="DefendingTheDocks">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=faction|Republic|Defending the Docks|Mek-Sha}}</ref>

Following this, the fleet arrived to defend against the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex|attack]] on the Meridian Complex, and helped to successfully fight off the Imperial Fleets.<ref name="Objective Meridian">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=faction|Republic|Objective Meridian|Mek-Sha}}</ref>
{{EndGame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Twenty-Ninth Fleet appears during the ''Onslaught'' expansion for the game ''Star Wars: The Old Republic''.<ref name="GangsOfMekSha" /> If the player character is a Republic Loyalist or an Imperial Saboteur, they will save the fleet from being destroyed by the Empire.<ref name="DefendingTheDocks" /> However, if the player character is an Imperial Loyalist or a Republic Saboteur, they will successfully destroy the fleet and prevent it from being present during the defense of the Meridian Complex.<ref name="TheFailsafe">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=faction|Imperial|The Failsafe|Mek-Sha}}</ref>
